content.text: No exclusivity binds AP — the agreement expressly disclaims it.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: Section 1 (Kubient Services) expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms AP remains free to offer Inventory through other agents or sell it to third parties, so no sole-supplier or requirements obligation binds us. A document-wide check of "exclusive" found only unobjectionable uses: a non-exclusive license to AP (p0002), exclusive jurisdiction/venue (p0064), each Party's ownership of its own marks (p0065), the entire-agreement clause (p0072) and a no-third-party-beneficiary provision (p0073); no non-compete or "all requirements" wording appears. This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity on Customer), so no redline is warranted.
